name: Vryssa
description: Vryssa was a planet located within the Vryssa system of the Outer Rim Territories that hosted an Imperial garrison base. Buldobeasts were commonly found on this planet. At some point in 1 ABY, the entire garrison was wiped out by Boba Fett while pursuing the bounty on Rivo Xarran.
